YouTube ek naya test kar raha hai (29 October ko bataya gaya).
👉 Kuch spam violations par channel turant hat-ne ki jagah 30 din ke liye lock hoga
👉 Is dauran video edit ya delete karke sudhaar sakte ho
👉 30 din mein kuch nahi kiya to channel permanently hat sakta hai

Ye abhi sirf test hai aur har violation par lagu nahi hai. Rules padhte raho.

Aapne YouTube ke rules kab padhe the? Comment mein batao 👇
